observed_behavior: High-visibility web UI copy exposed implementation details such as protocol/NIP numbers, ContextVM transport wording, signer-first wording, EOSE, and CLOSED.
Light-mode markdown code blocks used the inline-code background path and could render with poor code-block contrast.
intended_behavior: Operator-facing UI uses product-level language unless protocol detail is necessary for diagnostics or developer-facing configuration.
Relay lifecycle implementation terms remain in code and diagnostics where required, but high-visibility route labels, buttons, helper text, and empty states avoid unnecessary protocol jargon.
Markdown code blocks use the code-block theme tokens and render as white text on a dark block background in light mode.
out_of_scope: Renaming persisted schema fields such as contextvm_relays or callback names such as onEose/onClosed.
Removing protocol terms from low-level Nostr libraries, protocol tests, or internal event validation code.
